updates.name: David C. Goodrich
updates.bio: Retired research hydraulic engineer at USDA-ARS's Southwest Watershed Research Center in Tucson, where he worked from 1988. His research spanned scaling of semiarid runoff, remote sensing in hydrologic models, riparian systems, flash-flood forecasting and post-fire assessment, including KINEROS2 and AGWA tools. He co-led the San Pedro SALSA program and is an AGU Fellow.

updates.current_affiliation: Southwest Watershed Research Center, USDA Agricultural Research Service, Tucson, AZ
